figures.caption: Fig. 3 Hierarchical clustering of 12 languages by AI-narrative similarity (average linkage on 1− mean BGE-M3 cosine). Slavic {cs, pl, sk} and Baltic {et, lt, lv} recover as clean groups; Finnish clusters with the Germanic languages. Cophenetic correlation 0.915.

Fig. 2 Home-language minus English change for local champions versus global brands. The homelanguage advantage is large for recommendation share and concentrated in local champions; the sentiment change is small and does not separate the tiers.
Fig. 1 Mean AI brand-reputation sentiment by query language, coloured by language family. Uralic and Baltic languages read most positive; Germanic languages, including English, read most critical.
